newsitem.title: USA: U.S. vice president Gore to travel to Bolivia.
newsitem.headline: U.S. vice president Gore to travel to Bolivia.

text.p: U.S. vice president Al Gore will make a one-day trip to Bolivia next month to attend a hemispheric conference on sustainable development, the White House said on Friday.
"(Gore) will travel to Santa Cruz, Bolivia on Dec. 7 to lead the U.S. delegation to the Summit of the Americas on sustainable development," it said in a statement.

Representatives from all 34 member countries of the Organisation of the American States are due to attend the two-day meeting in Santa Cruz de la Sierra to discuss joint efforts on environmental and social issues.
Communist-ruled Cuba is the only country not invited to the conference, which is part of a hemispheric integration process launched at the Summit of the Americas held in Miami in December, 1994.
